Episode 162. Smarion Proch(1)
The Wave-Tracking Synchronous Space-Leap Ship, the Red Owl, was not influenced by chaos particles unlike the transport portal.

The manual stated that the space-time device built into the Red Owl works differently from the teleportation through magic of the conventional transport portals, because it moves through the formless 'wave' existing in the world.
"I've seen failures breaking apart during space-leaping before... but it's hard to describe the abilities of Quaul and Valeria, my lord."
Though they had seen Zipple use a space-time device in the Kaipa military road, comparing the Red Owl to Zipple's technology at the time was a disrespect in itself.
"It feels like we're entering a completely new world after two years and six months."
Voooom...
A somber echo echoed from the forest surrounding Kwegoksaeseong.

The coordinates set on the Red Owl were the campsite of his colleagues and the Ghost Squad members. The fact that the Ghost Squad had formed a camp while giving up on Kwegoksaeseong, their headquarters, made the seriousness of the situation all the more tangible.
As the Red Owl slowly descended, all eyes were on the campsite.
Everyone was seeing the operation of the Red Owl for the first time.
Above all, the surprising fact was that Jin was among the passengers of the Red Owl.
"Commander Jin...!"
"You're back, Jin!"
The members of the Ghost Squad saluted, and his colleagues ran to him, shouting his name.
Quikantel, Alisa, Kujan, Beris, Yulian, Enya, Lata, Faye, Amela. And about 30% of the Black King members and more than 80% of the Ghost Squad members.
Tikan had concentrated on Smarion, leaving only the minimum power needed for defense.
Everyone had a haggard face from an operation that had been ongoing for over three months.
'The intensely thick chaos covering Kwegoksaeseong and the entire forest is horrific... Those who are not trained would have gone mad just being nearby.'
Even without trying to be aware, the nerves of his body were on edge.
Although others vaguely sensed the enormity of the chaos engulfing Kwegoksaeseong by Smarion, it was far from the level Jin was perceiving.
They didn't have the senses at Jin's level.
Such a vast energy could be properly recognized by at least a Two-King of the Myung King clan.
For a while, words of asking each other's well-being were exchanged. However, given the situation, the conversation quickly switched to discussing the matter at hand.
"I'm sorry to burden you with this as soon as you return, my lord," said Lata in a somber voice.

"The reason I showed you this place first, Lord, is because it's currently the biggest and only problem of the Ghost Corps. Embarrassingly, one could say that this seal threatens the existence of the Ghost Corps.
From the moment I decided to welcome you as our lord, I've felt guilty for burdening you with the danger called 'Smarien Proch.'

"Lord Lata, please do not speak like that. Since the moment you became our comrade, this has been everyone's problem. If anything, I should be sorry for leaving my position while the situation has gotten to this state."
When Lata bowed his head, Amela approached Jin's side.
"Our cutie had a hard time trying to solve this before the lord came. So everyone tried, but with our power, we couldn't help but..."
Thankfully, the chaos of Amela, Lata, and Fey did not resonate with the energy of the curved bird castle.
Jin took out the Chaos Purifier he had brought.
"This is a chaos purifier made by the Ming clan brothers. I brought it just in case, but I think that Lord Lata and Fey's father are not in a state to be helped with this."
The Chaos Purifier was effective only for those infected before total erosion and physical transformation.
Smarien had been out of the norm since the moment it was sealed, and even if not, the size of the chaos itself was too huge.
Therefore, the only way to resolve the situation was extermination, as purification was impossible.
"......Jin. If you're worried about having to kill my father and brother, you don't have to. The reason we've been on standby here in the first place was to handle the monster that was our father."
Lata and Fey did not have a good memory of Smarien. They had only received abuse and training since they were young.
In fact, the emotion that came to mind when the siblings thought of their father was closer to hatred.
But it wasn't as if they had no ordinary family memories at all.
When Chiron, worried about Smarien's chaos, visited the curved bird castle, he became a kind father, sitting them on his lap and giving them snacks.
It happened only a few times, but it must have been a precious moment in their childhood for the Proch siblings, even if they hated Smarien enough not to want to admit it.

"We rather think that it's our duty as Ghost Corps to get rid of that monster as soon as possible. It's the right thing to do for our comrades. Of course, it's shameless to burden you with this, even after considering all of that... but we ask you, Lord."
Jin nodded heavily.
Then, Quicantel informed him of the approximate situation so far. According to her, there have already been three chaos explosions in the curved bird castle.
The first explosion resulted in about thirty casualties, and thanks to the expanded cordon in advance, there were no injuries from the second explosion.
"......The explosions are getting more frequent and stronger. If it continues like this, it's highly likely that the damage will reach the nearby Vermont territories beyond the entire forest."
"As Gwigoksaeseong is within Vermont, Dante has already been supporting the Vamel Alliance.
Knights of Hairan and Feralga have completely blocked the area. So that the risk factors of the Vamel Alliance are not exposed to other major powers, preventing them from using it.
In the meantime, our allies could only wait without being able to do anything.
They couldn't proceed first for suppression because the expected damage was too great and they might even be 'annihilated'.
This was because their main allies, Talaris, Misha, Murakan, and Jin, were absent.
"We dissuaded Dante Hairan from directly going for suppression."
If the seal completely breaks and it is determined that the Vamel Alliance can't handle it on their own, then Dante would have no choice but to step in.
Dante is the hope of the Empire and the ruler who has the support of all the people. It was right to exclude him from participating in the suppression as much as possible in the uncertain situation.
Moreover, Dante had no spare time as he was personally visiting the polluted areas within the Empire and even keeping in check the major powers alone.
If Dante chooses Gwigoksaeseong for Jin and his allies in the meantime, more people will die elsewhere.
"You did well."
Jin looked at the main gate of Gwigoksaeseong.
'Smarion Proch... is he aware that I've come?'
The energy of chaos spreading around Gwigoksaeseong was deepening. It was a phenomenon that started right after Jin's arrival, and he recognized the fact accurately.
As if waiting for his enemy, the energy of chaos that Smarion was spreading was slowly focusing on Jin.
Jin looked at the powerful energy calmly. And he made a decision immediately.
"Let's rest for a day and enter Gwigoksaeseong tomorrow morning."
It took a little while to recover from the energy spent and injuries sustained in the battle with Lanke.
"Tomorrow?"
"Yes, if the seal can hold until tomorrow, no. It would be more accurate to say, if Smarion Proch waits for me until then. He is already in a state where he can break through the seal."
"What do you mean?"
"As soon as I came, Smarion's energy is amplifying. It couldn't grow at such a fast speed if the seal hasn't completely lost its function. The thick color and hostility are all directed at me."
The allies don't know if Jin has achieved something or gotten used to the sensation of some existence. They only have a vague feeling that he has become stronger.
Therefore, they wondered if he could really suppress Smarion alone even if he has become so strong, but they didn't express it. Because he was Jin.
"So what should we do?"
Jin turned his gaze and examined the 'artifacts' installed at the campsite.
They were artifacts he had personally experienced on the first day he met Qwaul in the shack.
They were artifacts that boasted all kinds of obstacles, including the blue rod 'Aura Interferer' and the net, which were created for the Grand Knights War.

"Please prepare for the aftermath of the battle nearby. If the protective shield is not tightly constructed, damage can reach nearby cities. And please concentrate all Aura Interferers on the battlefield where I and Smarion fight."
"Do you mean those skilled enough to withstand the shockwave should maintain their distance and continue to use the Interferer on you and Smarion?"
"That's correct, Quicantel."
Of course, doing so would inevitably place some restrictions on the use of aura by Jin and Smarion. Naturally, that much less external damage would occur.
If Jin were a typical non-magician, it would have been a method that should never be used. Because Smarion can use the power of chaos even without aura.
However, Jin has the spirit energy and magical power.

"I can't precisely predict how far the impact of the battle will spread, so it will definitely be better if both my and Smarion's power are reduced. As long as the performance of the Interferer can back it up."
"Is there another matter?"
"Please prevent damage to the empire's land outside of Gwigoksaeseong by mobilizing all possible means. And make sure there are no problems with the Red Owl. That will be it."
The next day at noon.
Fortunately, Jin was able to head to Gwigoksaeseong after a full day of rest.
He couldn't have more conversation with his allies because he meditated all night.
Jin classified Smarion as a target that required such concentrated attention.
"As soon as I enter, there is a high possibility that the battle will start immediately. So Quicantel, Sir Valkas, Sir Amela, and Enya, be especially careful."
"Yes, sir!"
These four were closest to the battlefield and played the role of protecting the Interferers and those who used them.
Enya's dragon fire barrier and the power of time that Quicantel possessed were at the core of the protective shield.
Around five hundred Interferers were located near Gwigoksaeseong. That was more than 80% of the Interferers currently held by the Vamel Alliance.
"Lord, I wish you luck."
"Don't worry too much, everyone."
Jin turned his head to Lata and Pay. The two were still uncomfortable about entrusting him with this role, but they were wearing stern looks to avoid making him more uncomfortable.
"If we hadn't met you, our Ghost Corps would have definitely been annihilated by that monster that once devoured my father, just like our mother was. Don't get hurt, Lord."
After patting the Proch siblings' shoulders once, Jin stepped towards Gwigoksaeseong.
